### Faithless Shepherds Condemned
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/faithless-shepherds-condemned
Passage: Zechariah 10:1-12
Points:
- Post-exilic Judah continued to struggle with superstition, trusting false guides rather than seeking the Lord for their needs.
- The leaders failed to provide righteous guidance, bringing divine judgment upon themselves for neglecting God's flock.
- The historical return from Babylon was only an initial step toward the full restoration God intended.
- Zechariah pointed toward a greater future gathering uniting both Judah and Israel in divine blessing.
- Receiving God's promised blessings calls His people to present trust and faithful obedience.
